summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K announcing the sale of HSBC Life (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. to Allianz via a share purchase agreement. Consideration is S$2.7 billion (US$2.1 billion). The sale follows a strategic review and is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to Monetary Authority of Singapore approval. HSBC expects a pre-tax gain of US$1.8 billion and a 15 basis-point CET1 increase. Post-closing, HSBC and Allianz will enter a 15-year exclusive bancassurance distribution agreement with an initial S$0.2 billion payment. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration risk-arb.
